limits: No external page was opened. Every result below is derived from the committed capture (fixture facts stamped 2026-10-24T17:35Z; OLBG hubs re-read by the owning session up to 18:06Z); a source link proves where a value was read at capture, not what the page shows now.
Fixtures that the underlying desk left blank (no originated line) are outside price and prose checks; their reasons are published on now/flagged.html.

OLBG publishes one side per event, so the desk's prices on quoted-market rows are a normalised read of the OLBG quote, not an independent second-source price. This session cannot add a second source because those hosts are unreachable here.
Injury and line-up news after the 17:35Z capture is not reflected anywhere in the committed data and cannot be retrieved from this environment.
